title: Protocols of the Elders of Zion as a Russian secret police hoax

tellings.quote: We know it was a hoax invented by the secret police in Russia during the time of thesar even before the Soviet Union.

plain: The Protocols of the Elders of Zion, a text claiming to reveal a secret Jewish plan to rule the world, was made up by the Russian secret police in the time of the tsar, before there was a Soviet Union. Peter Levenda, billed on the episode as a CIA historian, tells Michels this as something "we know", without naming a source. He raises it as an example of how a secret police can invent a document and send it out into the world.
